title: Prototype of my card game: Back Row Card Club (free, browser, daily deal + play with friends)
author: Cadboy72
selftext:
I get bored in class, and I figured out there aren't any good free poker games where you can play with your friends and also have a good time solo. So I started making my own.



It started as Texas Hold'em, then I thought other card games would be cool too, so now it has:



\- Hold'em: bots, a career mode with 5 venues and bosses, poker puzzles and a learn mode

\- Solitaire: Draw 1, Draw 3, and you can play a numbered deal to race a friend on the same shuffle

\- War: a ranked ladder from Recruit to General, plus blitz and total war modes

\- Uno: you vs 3 bots, match to 200, stacking rules



The main thing is the Daily Deal. Everyone gets the same 5 poker hands each day, kind of like Wordle or Connections, and there's a leaderboard for the day. You get one official run, and you can share your result. There's also a Daily Solitaire and a Daily Uno.



Play with friends: one person makes a room and shares a 5-letter code. Works for Hold'em, Uno (up to 4) and War (1v1). No account or sign-up.



There's also a Chromebook mode, because me and my friends play on school Chromebooks and they struggle with anything heavy. It strips out the animations and effects so it runs smooth on slow laptops.



It's still a prototype, so I'd really appreciate it if you tried it and told me:

\- what's confusing or broken

\- what you'd add

\- whether the daily deal would make you come back



Link: [https://ephemeral-cucurucho-ffec0c.netlify.app](https://ephemeral-cucurucho-ffec0c.netlify.app)
